rv.q: It's hard to imagine 'American Idiot' receiving a better, bolshier treatment, but only you and your misspent youth can decide if that's enough.
Being stoned does not make you the world’s most interesting dramatis personae.
There is at the heart of this musical a story worth caring about and Racky Plews stages it masterfully.

cn.t: Green Day's pop-punk musical divides critics with its grungy, alternative aesthetic and adolescent angst, feeling dated in its Bush-era nostalgia while offering an edgy alternative to traditional glitzy West End fare.
